0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000010_ILBERD
0.description: Hail to you, Scion. How might we serve you?

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000030_ILBERD
2.description: These are welcome tidings indeed. Given the sensitive nature of the task, I could not rely on one of my own.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000040_ILBERD
3.description: That which I am about to tell you, I tell you in the strictest confidence.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000050_ILBERD
4.description: Some days ago, we received certain documents from an anonymous source. They notified us of the presence of a Garlean agent within the ranks of one of the Grand Companies.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000060_ILBERD
5.description: Following some discreet inquiries, we identified a suspect among the Immortal Flames whom we detained for questioning.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000070_ILBERD
6.description: Alas, the man was not our agent. He was but one of many men in the agent's employ.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000080_ILBERD
7.description: We pressed the traitor for a name, but he had none to give. He claims never to have met his master, whom he knows only as the Ivy.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000090_ILBERD
8.description: He was, however, certain that this “ivy” had coiled itself around every part of the Immortal Flames. It would seem our quarry joined the company some time ago, and gradually recruited others to his cause.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000100_ILBERD
9.description: These conspirators are the vines by which he learns our secrets, all without exposing himself.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000110_ILBERD
10.description: It won't be easy to identify the Ivy amidst this tangled mass of subterfuge. But we have a tendril in our hands, and we shall follow it all the way to the gnarled root.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000120_ILBERD
11.description: Now, much as I would prefer to proceed with due discretion, circumstances demand that this matter be settled posthaste.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000130_ILBERD
12.description: Garlemald's war of succession nears its end, and it is feared that the Empire will soon resume its march on Eorzea.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000140_ILBERD
13.description: When it does, we can ill afford to have traitors in our midst. The Ivy must be rooted out now.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000150_ILBERD
14.description: We must begin by apprising General Raubahn of our findings. I would ask that you accompany me to the Hall of Flames, and remain on hand to see that things go smoothly.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000160_ILBERD
15.description: Assuming the Ivy's tendrils are as widespread as we believe, he will be aware that an investigation is underway. And if that is the case, he may well move against us.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_000170_ILBERD
16.description: We must be prepared for anything, while taking care not to betray our purpose by <hex:021A020203>seeming<hex:021A020103> prepared. A simple enough task for a one-<hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> army like you.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100010_RAUBAHN
17.description: Well, well. What brings you here, my friend?

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100011_ILBERD
18.description: <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> is here at my behest. Greetings, Raubahn. It has been a while.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100020_RAUBAHN
19.description: Ilberd, you old scoundrel! When they told me you'd be visiting, I scarce believed my ears!

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100030_RAUBAHN
20.description: But look at you! The honored captain of the Crystal bloody Braves! Who'd have imagined, eh?

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100040_ILBERD
21.description: Not many. But fewer still would have imagined your destiny lay in politics, old friend.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100050_RAUBAHN
22.description: Aye...we've both come far, have we not?

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100060_RAUBAHN
23.description: Lest you wonder, Ilberd and I go back a long way. We've been friends and rivals since we were lads.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100070_RAUBAHN
24.description: The last time we saw each other, Ala Mhigo had just fallen, so you can guess how many summers it's been. And in all that time, not a word from the fool!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100080_ILBERD
25.description: Ah, well, my dealings tended toward the modest and mundane...unlike some I could mention.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100090_ILBERD
26.description: As I hear it, no sooner did you reach Thanalan than the Brass Blades clapped you in irons and dragged you off to die on the bloodsands. But being a stubborn sort, you won a thousand matches, and earned yourself a place in the people's hearts while you were about it.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100100_ILBERD
27.description: Then, with your mountain of prize money, you bought the Coliseum, and secured a seat on the Syndicate. Thal's balls, brother─rags-to-riches does not do it justice! You're a hero to the common man!

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100110_RAUBAHN
28.description: Bah, spare me. I am no hero. If anyone is worthy of that title, it's our friend here. Next to <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>, I'm little more than a glorified butcher.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100120_RAUBAHN
29.description: But you, Ilberd─you sell yourself short. By all accounts, you were an adventurer of some standing.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100130_ILBERD
30.description: I like to think that I did my part for the greater good. But if you are no hero, then I am no adventurer─not in <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> company. Anyway...

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100160_RAUBAHN
33.description: I've let it be known that this meeting is a reunion between old friends. None will give your visit a second thought.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100170_RAUBAHN
34.description: To convene elsewhere would only attract attention. Let us speak here, in plain view of all.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100180_RAUBAHN
35.description: ...So it is we who have been compromised.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100190_RAUBAHN
36.description: Teledji Adeledji's machinations have shaken Ul'dah to her foundations. In such uncertain times, a man's loyalty may be bought for a fistful of gil...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100200_RAUBAHN
37.description: But if this snake has truly been in our midst for as long as you say, we must needs consider a far graver possibility: conspiracy. Could it be that the Monetarists have been in league with the Empire from the first?

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100210_RAUBAHN
38.description: Very well. I will have my most trusted men investigate the matter. Continue your inquiries in the meantime.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100220_RAUBAHN
39.description: It does me well to see you again, old friend. When next we meet, let it be over a flagon of ale.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100230_ILBERD
40.description: I look forward to it. Let us reminisce of bygone days, and drink to the future of our homeland.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100240_ILBERD
41.description: Flame General... You wear the mantle well, old friend. I must work hard if I'm to keep up.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_100250_ILBERD
42.description: Well, it would seem your services were not required after all. I daresay we have Raubahn's prudence to thank for that. Still, I was glad of your presence. My thanks, Scion.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300010_HAURCHEFANT
43.description: Have faith, my friend. You need only state your case with confidence and clarity.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300020_AYMERIC
44.description: (-???-)Commander Leveilleur. It is both an honor and a pleasure to meet you.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300030_AYMERIC
45.description: I am Aymeric, lord commander of the Temple Knights.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300050_ALPHINAUD
47.description: Your reputation precedes you, Ser Aymeric. I think we will find that we have much in common.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300060_AYMERIC
48.description: Speaking of reputations, yours towers over us all. Does it not?

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300080_LUCIA
49.description: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)It does indeed, Lord Commander.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300090_AYMERIC
50.description: I am not too proud to admit that I have followed your activities with an interest bordering on fascination.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300100_AYMERIC
51.description: Full glad was I to learn that you would be joining us.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300120_ALPHINAUD
53.description: We know full well that the Garleans will return in force ere long.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300130_ALPHINAUD
54.description: What is more, we have yet to achieve a lasting victory over the primal menace. The beast tribes continue to summon their gods, and each incarnation is stronger than the last.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300140_ALPHINAUD
55.description: Ishgard is not immune to these threats. I must reiterate that it would behoove your nation to rejoin the Eorzean Alliance.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300150_AYMERIC
56.description: Once again, I must respectfully disagree.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300170_AYMERIC
58.description: Despite their presence in Coerthas, the Ixal do not concern us. Their territorial claims pertain to Gridanian lands, and it is the people of Gridania whom they harry.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300180_AYMERIC
59.description: Consequently, the Holy See judges this to be a Gridanian affair, and Ishgard does not intervene in the internal affairs of other nations.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300190_AYMERIC
60.description: Even were that not the case, our forces are wholly committed to the Dravanian conflict. We have not the knights to spare.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300200_AYMERIC
61.description: As for the Garleans, we are not ignorant of history. We have observed the rise and expansion of the Empire, and we agree that it is only a matter of time before they resume their campaign in Eorzea.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300220_ALPHINAUD
62.description: Then surely it would be in our best interests to present a united front?

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300230_AYMERIC
63.description: Mayhap one day, but not yet.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300240_AYMERIC
64.description: Gaius van Baelsar is dead, and the legion of conscripts he left behind lacks the will to fight. We think it highly unlikely that they will emerge from behind the walls of their castra for some time.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300250_ALPHINAUD
65.description: Forgive me, but if Ishgard's position has not changed, why did you agree to this meeting?

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300260_AYMERIC
66.description: It was not only as a representative of Ishgard that I came here.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300280_AYMERIC
68.description: It is not within my power to change Ishgardian policy, regardless of my personal feelings. There is, however, one area in which I may exert a measure of influence.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300290_AYMERIC
69.description: Concerns have been raised over the supplies House Fortemps has offered to Revenant's Toll. These have led to calls for restrictions on the provision of aid to foreign powers.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300300_AYMERIC
70.description: I can ensure that the shipments continue unabated.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300310_HAURCHEFANT
71.description: Ser Aymeric, we would be in your debt!

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300320_AYMERIC
72.description: No, you would not, for I require something in exchange.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300330_AYMERIC
73.description: Of late there has been a flurry of Dravanian activity, the purpose of which was not immediately clear.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300340_AYMERIC
74.description: However, our astrologians have since observed alarming changes in the heavens. The dragon star waxes unnaturally bright, and there are whispers that it portends the resurrection of Midgardsormr.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300350_ALPHINAUD
75.description: The fallen guardian of Silvertear Falls? That's absurd.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300360_AYMERIC
76.description: Full many times have I gazed upon the dragon's corpse, still wound around the <hex:021A020203>Agrius<hex:021A020103>, and wondered how different our world might be if it yet lived to plague the skies.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300370_AYMERIC
77.description: I do not know, and I do not wish to know. Nor does any son of Ishgard. Yet the mere presence of Dravanian forces is not sufficient grounds to send knights to Mor Dhona, whatever our astrologians say. As I told you before, we have not the forces to spare.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300380_ALPHINAUD
78.description: ...But we do. So, you will intervene on our behalf if we agree to watch over the Keeper of the Lake.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300400_ALPHINAUD
80.description: I do. I will see that you are kept abreast of any developments.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300410_ALPHINAUD
81.description: I regret that we could not come to a similar agreement on other matters, but I understand that you are not at liberty to make such decisions.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300420_ALPHINAUD
82.description: Nevertheless, I hope that what we have accomplished here today will serve to demonstrate to your countrymen that we can work together towards a common goal. Mayhap one day we shall look back on this moment as the first step towards a united Eorzea.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300450_HAURCHEFANT
84.description: What is the meaning of this!?

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300460_CAVALRY02400
85.description: The caravan, my lord! It's been attacked!

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_300480_HAURCHEFANT
87.description: What!? By the Fury! All our precautions were for naught!?

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_600010_ICEHEART
88.description: (-???-)The tales do not do you justice, Warrior of Light.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_600020_ICEHEART
89.description: (-???-)Yes, I know who you are. And you know who I am.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_600030_ICEHEART
90.description: (-Iceheart-)I was given the name Ysayle, but I earned the name Iceheart.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_600040_ICEHEART
91.description: (-Iceheart-)This endless cycle of hatred, of bloodshed, of sorrow─ You would see it continue, O noble Warrior of Light?

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_600050_ICEHEART
92.description: (-Iceheart-)I would not. I <hex:021A020203>will not<hex:021A020103>. I will bring an end to this war between dragon and man─no matter the cost.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_600080_ICEHEART
93.description: (-Iceheart-)In time, you will come to understand that what we do, we do for the greater good.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900010_KANESENNA
95.description: Change has come to the Garlean Empire, and we must discuss the implications.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900011_MERLWYB
96.description: The rumors are true then? The war of succession is ended?

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900020_KANESENNA
97.description: It is. A new emperor reigns in Garlemald.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900040_KANESENNA
99.description: The birth and all-too-rapid expansion of the Garlean Empire is commonly attributed to the strategic brilliance of Solus zos Galvus, yet he did not rule alone. Several members of the royal household also distinguished themselves during his reign.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900050_KANESENNA
100.description: Nevertheless, it was the eldest son who stood to inherit the throne─until his most untimely passing.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900060_RAUBAHN
101.description: I thought us fortunate when I learned that the Emperor had died without naming a successor.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900070_ALPHINAUD
102.description: Would that the Garlean Empire had died with him.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900080_RAUBAHN
103.description: 'Twas the grandson and his uncle who had the strongest claims, was it not?

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900090_KANESENNA
104.description: Indeed. Yet claims count for little without the power to assert them. High Legatus Varis yae Galvus is a respected military leader─not so, his uncle.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900100_MERLWYB
105.description: So, young Varis has torn the crown from his uncle's grasp, and taken his place at the head of the Empire.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900120_KANESENNA
106.description: Given the troubled nature of his succession, the new emperor will require time to seal his grip on power. Yet have no doubt but that he shall, for there are none left with strength enough to oppose him.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900130_RAUBAHN
107.description: Since the success of Operation Archon, the remnants of the XIVth Legion and the forces occupying Ala Mhigo have done naught but fortify their positions.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900140_RAUBAHN
108.description: But you can be sure they'll be ready to march on us again, if their emperor gives the word.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900150_MERLWYB
109.description: <hex:021A020203>When<hex:021A020103>, not if. They say this Varis was so set upon Eorzean annexation that he spoke out against the Meteor project.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900160_KANESENNA
110.description: Plainly, the new emperor's intentions are of great concern to us all.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900170_KANESENNA
111.description: I propose that we set aside the Carteneau dispute for the present and discuss what measures the Alliance might take to prepare for a resumption of hostilities with Garlemald.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900171_KANESENNA
112.description: Moreover, I move that we reexamine the question of how our former allies in Ishgard might be persuaded to retake their place at our side. Could Eorzea but stand as one, 'twould deal a grave blow to our enemy's ambitions.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900180_ALPHINAUD
113.description: Well, I suppose we should be grateful that they have finally acknowledged the inevitability of imperial attack. Who knows, they may even do something about it.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900190_ALPHINAUD
114.description: If only the leaders of Ishgard would follow their example, and stop hiding behind their gates, praying for the coming storm to pass them by.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900200_ALPHINAUD
115.description: But that is a discussion for another time. At present, I am more concerned by the fact that the Alliance's mooted preparations will be made known to the Garleans many moons before their coming.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_900210_ALPHINAUD
116.description: So long as the Ivy eludes our grasp, no secret is safe.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_B00020_MINFILIA
118.description: None other. I bid you welcome to Revenant's Toll, and thank you for traveling so far on such short notice.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_B00030_MOENBRYDA
119.description: (-???-)Hah! As if I could ever say no to Urianger!

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_B00040_MINFILIA
120.description: Moenbryda is an accomplished Sharlayan scholar and an authority on aetheryte technologies.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_B00050_MINFILIA
121.description: She has played an invaluable role in our search for a means to capture Ascian souls.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00010_MINFILIA
123.description: Everyone, if I could have your attention!

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00011_MINFILIA
124.description: We have with us an esteemed guest who is come from Sharlayan to assist us.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00050_YDA
128.description: Well, of course it is! Moen and I are like twin sisters!

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00080_MINFILIA
131.description: I bid Moenbryda join us here that she might share with us her extensive knowledge of aetherytes.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00090_MINFILIA
132.description: Also, as many of you are already aware, she has been overseeing our research into white auracite─a sample of which she has been good enough to bring with her.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00110_MOENBRYDA
133.description: Well, I had to come, didn't I? You'd have to be bloody <hex:021A020203>daft<hex:021A020103> to turn your nose up at a chance like this. Where better to conduct my final tests than a land so steeped in aether you can taste it!?

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00120_URIANGER
134.description: 'Tis plain the passage of the years hath done little to dampen thy youthful spirits...

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00130_URIANGER
135.description: ...And nothing at all to reform thy youthful manner.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00140_MOENBRYDA
136.description: Urianger! Where in the hells've you been hiding?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00160_MOENBRYDA
138.description: I come all this way, and <hex:021A020203>that's<hex:021A020103> what you have to say to me!?

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00170_MOENBRYDA
139.description: I much preferred when you were pleading with me to drop everything and hurry to your side. What was it you said? “None save thee can satisfy this need─”

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00190_URIANGER
141.description: Th-Thine artless attempts to misrepresent mine all-too-innocent motives do thee little credit!

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00200_URIANGER
142.description: Mine intent, as well thou knowest, was but to impress upon thee the gravity of the circumstance. Lest thou doubt, a deiform entity shall shortly be summoned, save if thou, and no other, grantest my compeers thine aid.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00210_MOENBRYDA
143.description: You still haven't found it, then? Your missing aetheryte?

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00230_MINFILIA
145.description: We know that Iceheart teleported to an aetheryte not far from the first, yet even after careful analysis, we could not locate the second beacon.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00240_MINFILIA
146.description: We now suspect that the heretics destroyed the second aetheryte to impede our pursuit.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00250_MINFILIA
147.description: Our allies continue to scour Snowcloak for Iceheart's sanctuary, but we have no guarantee that they will find it. Yet it must be found, for even now Iceheart prepares to call upon Saint Shiva.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00260_MOENBRYDA
148.description: I'm sorry but...if the aetheryte's been destroyed, then that's that.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00270_MOENBRYDA
149.description: Although... You're absolutely sure she used the first aetheryte, are you? She didn't just use teleportation magicks?

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00280_MINFILIA
150.description: One of our own bore witness to her escape. I can say with absolute certainty that Iceheart used the aetheryte.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00290_MOENBRYDA
151.description: In that case, there might be a way─so long as the aetherial current is still flowing.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00310_MOENBRYDA
153.description: We use the current to recreate the beacon.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00320_MOENBRYDA
154.description: As you know, aetherytes are a bit like lighthouses. We use them to reconstitute our physical forms when crossing the aetherial sea. Without them, we'd lose all sense of direction and our essence would dissipate.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00350_MOENBRYDA
155.description: However, we don't rely solely on these beacons. There are currents of aether which flow between them─currents which help guide us to our destination.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00360_MOENBRYDA
156.description: Now, these currents will gradually dwindle away to nothing if an aetheryte is destroyed. But if even a sluggish flow remains, we could theoretically use it to direct a surge of concentrated aether towards the void left by the beacon and thereby fill it up again.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00380_THANCRED
157.description: Like opening the floodgates to fill a dry riverbed. Though, correct me if I'm wrong, but would we not need a veritable reservoir of aether?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00390_PAPALYMO
158.description: In concert, we <hex:021A020203>might<hex:021A020103> manage to channel a sufficient volume, yet that is not my chief concern.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00400_PAPALYMO
159.description: To direct the flow of so great a volume of aether with the requisite precision would be a nigh-impossible task in itself.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00410_YSHTOLA
160.description: I barely succeeded in facilitating travel to an unattuned beacon. That which you describe sounds considerably more difficult.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00420_MOENBRYDA
161.description: And dangerous! Every person who has attempted to teleport in this fashion has died in the process. They, however, did not have white auracite at their disposal!

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00440_MOENBRYDA
162.description: I can use it to channel all the aether you can give me into the aetheryte. However, white auracite cannot retain aether for an extended period of time, so we would need to infuse it immediately beforehand.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00450_MOENBRYDA
163.description: Just so you know, I'd confidently give this plan better than even odds of success. And if the worst comes to the worst, your people won't suffer.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00490_MINFILIA
164.description: Though it risk the lives of our best and brightest, we have not the time to seek other options.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00500_MINFILIA
165.description: If the aetherial current still flows, we shall carry out Moenbryda's plan.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_C00510_MOENBRYDA
166.description: That's the spirit! Let's roll the dice!

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_D00010_ICEHEART
167.description: You should never have come here, Warrior of Light. I labor only to forge a lasting peace.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_D00020_ICEHEART
168.description: A peace you would deny us out of ignorance and blind faith.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_D00030_ICEHEART
169.description: No matter. If it is our fate to be at odds, then it is <hex:021A020203>mine<hex:021A020103> to strike you down.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_D00040_ICEHEART
170.description: We whom gods and men have forsaken shall be the instruments of our own deliverance!

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_D00050_ICEHEART
171.description: Partake of my flesh─fill this vessel with your light! Walk amongst your brothers and sisters once more!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_D00060_ICEHEART
172.description: O Saint Shiva, still the hatred within our hearts and bless us with eternal grace!

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_E00020_ICEHEART
175.description: (-Iceheart-)You of all people should understand the suffering war begets─that no sacrifice is too great if it brings an end to the violence.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_E00030_ICEHEART
177.description: (-Iceheart-)You fight in a war you do not understand─a pawn of liars and schemers.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_E00040_ICEHEART
178.description: (-Iceheart-)And they are no less ignorant than you! Following the creed of their fathers without question, never thinking to ask why.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_E00050_ICEHEART
179.description: (-Iceheart-)Trapped in a delusion of their own creation and blind to the truth.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_E00060_ICEHEART
180.description: (-Iceheart-)Warrior of Light, redemption is not beyond us.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_E00070_ICEHEART
181.description: (-Iceheart-)We who walk before may lead those who walk after.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_E00080_ICEHEART
182.description: (-Iceheart-)Seek the Keeper of the Lake. See with eyes unclouded.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_E00110_NABRIALES
185.description: (-???-)<hex:024804F2022303>And so the vessel withdraws. A predictable outcome.<hex:0248020103>

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00010_AYMERIC
188.description: On behalf of the Holy See of Ishgard, allow me to express my deepest thanks.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00020_AYMERIC
189.description: Never before have we been required to contend with a primal. Indeed, there were fears in some quarters that our knights might not be equal to the task.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00030_AYMERIC
190.description: From what we have now learned of these beings, I can say with certainty that we would have lost a great many men had the Scions not intervened.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00040_ALPHINAUD
191.description: Then the argument for preemptive action should be self-evident. Perchance now you will reconsider my proposal that Ishgard move against Natalan?

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00050_AYMERIC
192.description: Ere we first met, a similar proposal was tabled─but the Holy See decreed that we were to observe, and that military action should be taken only in self-defense.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00060_AYMERIC
193.description: All things considered, it was not an unreasonable decision. Since the Calamity, two vigils have fallen to the Horde, while Garuda has never shown any inclination to storm the Gates of Judgement.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00070_AYMERIC
194.description: ...Which is why this unprecedented crisis and its resolution may prompt a change in policy.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00080_AYMERIC
195.description: You who have faced these primals know well the threat they pose. Ishgard did not─not until now.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00090_AYMERIC
196.description: And there is naught like a brush with death to change a man's outlook.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00110_HAURCHEFANT
197.description: At the very least, this should silence any lingering objections to our arrangement with Revenant's Toll.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00120_HAURCHEFANT
198.description: The Holy See may even feel moved to grant us its formal endorsement.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00130_AYMERIC
199.description: So far as it is possible, the Scions shall be compensated for their service.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00140_ALPHINAUD
200.description: We should be grateful for any aid you can provide.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00150_AYMERIC
201.description: As a gesture of good faith, I shall withdraw my previous request. Your people are doubtless needed elsewhere.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00170_ALPHINAUD
203.description: We too have a vested interest in watching Dravania's movements.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00171_AYMERIC
204.description: I see. Once more, I must thank you.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00172_ALPHINAUD
205.description: Ser Aymeric, if I may... Do you truly believe that Midgardsormr could return?

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00180_AYMERIC
206.description: The heavens are a window unto truth, but those who interpret their movements are not infallible. I requested your involvement as a precautionary measure.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00190_ALPHINAUD
207.description: But of course... You sought an excuse to <hex:021A020203>compensate<hex:021A020103> us from the first, mindful of what would happen if Revenant's Toll were taken by your enemies.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00200_ALPHINAUD
208.description: Ishgard is not wont to aid its neighbors, but that does not preclude it from manipulating them to serve its own interests.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00210_LUCIA
209.description: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)Choose your next words carefully.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00220_AYMERIC
210.description: Do you know what sort of man becomes lord commander of the Temple Knights?

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00230_AYMERIC
211.description: One who comes from good stock. I did not, yet here I am. Now why do you suppose that is?

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00240_AYMERIC
212.description: Because I swiftly learned to tell the difference between words, deeds, and beliefs.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00250_AYMERIC
213.description: ...You are correct, Master Leveilleur. Ishgard desires to see Revenant's Toll flourish, as it would present a troublesome obstacle to our enemies from the south.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00260_ALPHINAUD
214.description: We are so glad to be of use to you.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00270_AYMERIC
215.description: As we are to you. Ours is a mutually beneficial arrangement, lest we forget. One born of necessity.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00280_AYMERIC
216.description: The dragons grow more restless by the day, and the heretics harry us nigh without cease.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00290_AYMERIC
217.description: We have contended with such troubles for centuries, but there are limits to even our endurance.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00300_AYMERIC
218.description: Yet as a pauper is loath to part with his meager possessions, the leaders of Ishgard are not wont to render up their trust to outsiders.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00310_AYMERIC
219.description: But with perseverance on <hex:021A020203>our<hex:021A020103> part, they may yet be made to see the light.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00320_AYMERIC
220.description: Nevertheless, one must take care when walking the road less traveled.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00330_ALPHINAUD
221.description: Wise words, Ser Aymeric. I shall make a point to remember them.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00340_ALPHINAUD
222.description: I must apologize for my earlier outburst. I hope it will not sour our good relations.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00350_AYMERIC
223.description: Not at all. You but spoke from the heart.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00360_AYMERIC
224.description: I trust you understand that, at times, my duties may prevent me from meeting with you.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00370_AYMERIC
225.description: On such occasions, my second-in-command will speak for me.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00390_LUCIA
227.description: (-Lucia-)Pray excuse our reticence. We are but wary of speaking too freely, lest our sentiments be made known to our enemies.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00400_LUCIA
228.description: (-Lucia-)Know that the lord commander and I are of one mind. For the sake of Ishgard─and of Eorzea at large─I pray our peoples can put aside their differences.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00410_LUCIA
229.description: (-Lucia-)Those who dwell in the past risk losing sight of their future.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00420_AYMERIC
230.description: Should aught befall one of our shipments, pray inform Lucia immediately. You may also relay to her any words you might have for me alone.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00430_AYMERIC
231.description: Not being of Ishgardian birth, she owes no allegiance to any noble house, making her as near to incorruptible as one can find in my homeland. Suffice it to say, I trust her completely, and so may you.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00440_AYMERIC
232.description: Which reminds me─ Lord Haurchefant, if you would be so kind.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00460_AYMERIC
234.description: In times such as these, trust is ever in short supply. Mayhap this will go some way to rectify the problem.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00470_AYMERIC
235.description: The results of our investigation into the heretics' recent attacks, as well as our interrogation of the merchant you detained.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00480_ALPHINAUD
236.description: Ser Aymeric... I cannot thank you enough.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00490_AYMERIC
237.description: Think nothing of it. Ishgard may be many things, but it is no friend to Garlemald.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_F00500_HAURCHEFANT
238.description: Did I not tell you to have faith, my friend?

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00010_MINFILIA
239.description: Words cannot well express how glad I am to see you returned to us hale and whole.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00011_MINFILIA
240.description: Needless to say, I am most eager to hear your account of that which occurred in Coerthas─assuming you are ready to speak of it?

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00020_MINFILIA
241.description: Excellent. I shall summon the others at once.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00030_MINFILIA
242.description: Iceheart used <hex:021A020203>her own body<hex:021A020103> as a vessel for a primal's soul?

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00040_YSHTOLA
243.description: Master Louisoix's writings make no mention of such a possibility. Can we be certain this entity was a primal?

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00050_PAPALYMO
244.description: As certain as we can be that Good King Moggle Mog XII was a primal, I should think. Both were ostensibly summoned.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00060_THANCRED
245.description: Let's not quibble over definitions. Of more concern is the implication that Iceheart retained her will even after she was possessed. We are talking about a mortal wielding the power of a primal!

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00070_YDA
246.description: It can't possibly be that easy, can it? There must be some sort of sacrifice required. Or maybe she's just special?

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00080_URIANGER
247.description: What qualities this woman possesseth, I know not, but full sure am I that she was groomed for this role.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00090_URIANGER
248.description: Few are privy to the secrets of summoning, and but a single party standeth to profit from their dissemination.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00100_MOENBRYDA
249.description: Well, I wouldn't presume to comment on how the lass came to know about summoning, but I <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> say that what she summoned was a primal. The readings were the same, or near as damn it.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00110_MOENBRYDA
250.description: Strange as it all sounds, it's really no different from what you've faced before.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00120_YSHTOLA
251.description: Then mayhap it is time that we reexamined our previous encounters.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00130_PAPALYMO
252.description: Pack your things, Yda. We're going back to Gridania.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00150_MINFILIA
254.description: About Iceheart's final words to you...

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00211_MINFILIA
257.description: If Iceheart is blessed with the power of the Echo, she will doubtless have used it to further her goals.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00212_MINFILIA
258.description: ...Or could it be that it was a revelation granted her by the Echo which first set her on this path? She did say that the Ishgardians were blind to the truth.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00213_MINFILIA
259.description: Do you think she has knowledge of the origins of the Ishgardian-Dravanian war? It would do much to explain her unwavering conviction.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00220_URIANGER
260.description: Did not the Lady Iceheart implore thee to seek the Keeper of the Lake? And did she not imply that in so doing thou wouldst come to see with eyes unclouded?

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00230_MINFILIA
261.description: Midgardsormr was a king amongst kings who reigned for centuries on end... But he is dead, and his wisdom lost to the ages─unless the Ishgardians' fears are well founded...

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00240_MINFILIA
262.description: It would seem we have yet another reason to stand watch over the Keeper of the Lake. For a mercy, we are well positioned to do so.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_G00280_MINFILIA
263.description: Iceheart, Shiva, Ascians, and Midgardsormr. I shudder to think how they are all connected...

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_H00010_TELEDJIADELEDJI
264.description: I have heard. Truly bothersome business.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_H00020_TELEDJIADELEDJI
265.description: No, I do not foresee a problem on that front. The main concern is Raubahn─there is no telling what the brute might do.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_H00030_TELEDJIADELEDJI
266.description: Have the Blades watch him and the Flames day and night.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_H00040_TELEDJIADELEDJI
267.description: You may leave the sultana to me. I shall personally attend Her Grace.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_H00060_TELEDJIADELEDJI
269.description: Sever one of the East Aldenard trade routes. That ought to keep Lolorito occupied for a while.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_H00070_TELEDJIADELEDJI
270.description: Nanamo Ul Namo... For my sake, pray be a good little sultana to the last.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00010_MINFILIA
271.description: Welcome back, my friend. I have already received word from Alphinaud.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00011_MINFILIA
272.description: To think that Flame Marshal Roaille was the Garlean agent... I know not what to say.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00020_MINFILIA
273.description: Together with Raubahn, Eline lent us much-needed aid at the time of our order's founding. She was particularly passionate about the need to tackle the primal threat.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00030_MINFILIA
274.description: When we discussed the subject, her eyes fairly shone with determination. Whatever else she may have been, I choose to believe that it was her true self with whom I spoke then...

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00040_MINFILIA
275.description: But now is not the time to dwell on such matters.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00050_MINFILIA
276.description: I have an important announcement to make regarding our effort to defeat the Ascians. We shall begin as soon as everyone is assembled.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00060_MINFILIA
277.description: My thanks for coming, friends. Moenbryda, the floor is yours.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00070_MOENBRYDA
278.description: By now, I'm sure you're all familiar with white auracite, the miraculous material that'll allow us to capture Ascian souls.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00080_MOENBRYDA
279.description: Back at Snowcloak, we verified its ability to absorb vast amounts of aether.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00090_MOENBRYDA
280.description: Alas, it leaves something to be desired in the area of stability. The stone can only store aether for a short while before expelling its contents.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00100_URIANGER
281.description: In addition to auracite's inherent limitations, we must needs be wary of our enemy's strength.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00110_URIANGER
282.description: Our foe draweth upon an infinite wellspring of power. Even should we succeed in entrapping him, the stone will not long contain his wrath.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00120_MOENBRYDA
283.description: Meaning that if we want to kill the swine, we'll have to be quick about it.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00130_URIANGER
284.description: 'Tis our belief that an Ascian soul may be permanently undone if smitten by a sufficiently concentrated burst of pure aether.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00140_MOENBRYDA
285.description: The only trouble is, we can't say for sure how concentrated the burst needs to be... Without knowing how much aether an Ascian soul is composed of, we're basically guessing.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00150_URIANGER
286.description: Our sole clue lieth in thy struggle with Lahabrea.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00160_MINFILIA
287.description: During that encounter, Hydaelyn bid you forge what She called “a blade of Light,” a weapon which took the form of a luminous stream of energy.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00170_MINFILIA
288.description: Based on your description, we believe the “blade” with which you vanquished your foe was composed of aether.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00180_MINFILIA
289.description: Admittedly, your victory proved ephemeral, as Lahabrea was able to use a Crystal of Darkness to flee into the space that lies between our world and the void.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00190_MINFILIA
290.description: The fact remains, however, that Hydaelyn placed the means to destroy the Ascians in your hands.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00200_MINFILIA
291.description: Be that as it may, it would be unwise to assume that She will do the same when next we encounter such a foe.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00210_URIANGER
292.description: Quite so, my lady. We must needs find the means to forge our own blade of aether─one to equal that which Hydaelyn did benevolently bestow upon Her champion.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00220_PAPALYMO
293.description: That is all well and good, but it seems to me that producing such a blade will require a prodigious quantity of aether. Whence will it come, pray tell?

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00230_YDA
294.description: Ummm... Oh! What if we had <hex:021A020203>two<hex:021A020103> pieces of white auracite? One to trap the Ascian, and the other to store the aether for the blade!

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00240_MOENBRYDA
295.description: Nice try, but it's as I said: the stone won't hold aether for any length of time. We'd still need to collect the stuff there and then, sorry to say.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00250_THANCRED
296.description: And therein lies the rub: finding a way to create the blade whenever and wherever we choose.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00260_YSHTOLA
297.description: 'Twould seem more research is in order.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00270_MOENBRYDA
298.description: I'm going to linger awhile─perform a few more tests on the auracite.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00280_MOENBRYDA
299.description: And I could do with some help. Urianger, why don't you lend me a hand?

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00290_URIANGER
300.description: M-Mine apologies, but I am required at the Waking Sands.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00300_URIANGER
301.description: Lady Minfilia hath given me sole charge of the premises. 'Twould be unseemly to leave them unattended.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00310_MOENBRYDA
302.description: "Sole charge,“ you say? So...you're basically <hex:021A020203>alone<hex:021A020103> there, then? Well, that settles it! I'll just have to come to you!

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00320_MINFILIA
303.description: While you were afield, word arrived from the Sharlayan motherland.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00330_MINFILIA
304.description: You will recall that a survey party was dispatched to investigate the incident at the Isle of Val. What they discovered was troubling to say the least.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00340_MINFILIA
305.description: According to the report, the isle has been erased from existence. 'Twas as if a hole had been torn in the very fabric of reality.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00350_URIANGER
306.description: Aye...yet the mystery endeth not with the isle's disappearance.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00360_URIANGER
307.description: It hath come to light that a number of scholars in various other locales were reported missing at a similar juncture.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00370_MOENBRYDA
308.description: What's more, they all had something in common with the head of the Students of Baldesion. Every last one of them was researching a phenomenon called dimensional compression─or the “Rejoining,” as the ancient texts call it. I'll be damned if <hex:021A020203>that's<hex:021A020103> a coincidence.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00380_MINFILIA
309.description: All indications suggest Ascian involvement, but I sense that a force greater still is at work─the entity the dark beings call “the one true god”...

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_I00390_MINFILIA
310.description: We must pray that my dear friend Krile regains consciousness soon. If she bore witness to the Isle of Val's final moments, she may be able to shed some light on this mystery...

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00010_RAUBAHN
311.description: Following the Calamity, the forces of the XIVth Imperial Legion entrenched themselves in strategic locations across Eorzea.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00020_RAUBAHN
312.description: So swiftly did they accomplish this, it was suspected that they had received help. To think that it came from Roaille... My right hand.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00030_ILBERD
313.description: There is more. We have reason to believe that Roaille didn't deal exclusively with the XIVth. She also answered to a higher authority in Garlemald.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00040_ILBERD
314.description: But this higher authority could not have been the Emperor. By consenting to the Meteor project, Solus zos Galvus showed himself to be more concerned about preventing the spread of primal influence than claiming Eorzea for the Empire. He would happily have seen the lot reduced to ash.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00050_ILBERD
315.description: We believe a number of high-ranking figures within the royal household were against the decision, but that they knew better than to oppose the Emperor openly. Of course, this didn't prevent them from making clandestine provisions, in which Roaille played a part.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00060_ALPHINAUD
316.description: Alas, these provisions did not prevent Dalamud from falling, and the ensuing chaos changed the face of the realm forever. Yet Eorzea survived.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00070_ALPHINAUD
317.description: To all intents and purposes, the Meteor project had failed, and the Empire was left to rue its lack of a decisive means to eliminate the primals. Until, that is, it stumbled upon the Ultima Weapon.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00080_RAUBAHN
318.description: Even before the accursed thing was dug up, it seemed to me the XIVth had the might to overwhelm our weakened armies. Yet they chose to hide behind their walls. Why?

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00090_ALPHINAUD
319.description: The Black Wolf was wary of making the denizens of Eorzea desperate, lest more primals emerge to bleed the land. The discovery of the Ultima Weapon, however, emboldened him to resume his war of conquest in earnest.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00100_ILBERD
320.description: But there was one in Garlemald who believed that van Baelsar's actions were premature─one who stood higher in the imperial army's chain of command. He ordered the legatus to halt his advance, only to find that the Black Wolf had slipped its leash, and that the XIVth now acted alone.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00110_ILBERD
321.description: In a bid to bring van Baelsar to heel, he used the agent he had planted in Ul'dah prior to the Calamity to undermine the legion's efforts.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00120_RAUBAHN
322.description: A man who outranks van Baelsar, yet opposed the late emperor's decision to annihilate Eorzea... This could only be the former high legatus of the Garlean Army, now known as Emperor Varis zos Galvus.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00130_RAUBAHN
323.description: So he was Roaille's true master...

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00140_ILBERD
324.description: But one of several, in actual fact. We've learned that even as Roaille served the Empire's interests, she sold imperial secrets to a certain faction in Eorzea.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00150_ILBERD
325.description: In so doing, she helped to maintain the status quo, thus prolonging the conflict. Considering who stands to profit from war, it isn't hard to imagine who her other masters were.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00160_RAUBAHN
326.description: Seven hells... You mean to say that she was a double agent?

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00170_ILBERD
327.description: Triple, if you consider her services to van Baelsar and the new emperor as separate.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00180_ALPHINAUD
328.description: As neatly as these pieces seem to fit, one aspect of the puzzle remains unclear to me.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00190_ALPHINAUD
329.description: By whose will was the marshal feeding intelligence to the heretics? And try as I might, I fail to see how aiding their cause would profit either her imperial or Monetarist masters.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00200_ALPHINAUD
330.description: Could it be that another hand is at work here? If so, Roaille must be made to reveal whose it is.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00210_RAUBAHN
331.description: Not only have I lost a trusted friend; now I must interrogate her as a stranger.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00220_ILBERD
332.description: Not a pleasant task, I grant you, but a necessary one. Unless we weed out the Ivy, root, stalk, and stem, it will simply grow back.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00230_RAUBAHN
333.description: I know that full well. Those closest to Roaille have already been detained, and I will question them alongside her.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00240_ALPHINAUD
334.description: General. Pray keep in mind that there may be unwitting abettors among them.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00250_RAUBAHN
335.description: All will be treated fairly─on that you have my word. Those who are innocent have no cause to fear.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00260_ALPHINAUD
336.description: You have ever been a friend of truth, General. I hope the unpleasant task of weeding out falsehood will not detain you too long. Though it be for the sake of Eorzea, doubting one's comrades is poison to the soul.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00270_ALPHINAUD
337.description: ...And with that, I take my leave.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00280_RAUBAHN
338.description: All these years, I've been made to dance to their tune...

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00290_RAUBAHN
339.description: How could you, Roaille? How could you side with <hex:021A020203>them<hex:021A020103>...?

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00300_RAUBAHN
340.description: ...Those <hex:021A020203>cankers<hex:021A020103> who take from this land and give naught in return─who use their power to disempower, and grow fat while the people starve!

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00310_RAUBAHN
341.description: I know you can hear me, Monetarist scum! Your crimes will not go unpunished!

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_J00320_RAUBAHN
342.description: One day, I will purge this land of your sickness! Before the eyes of the Twelve, I swear it!

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00010_NANAMOULNAMO
344.description: I shall have no further need of you this day.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00030_NANAMOULNAMO
346.description: I fear that not even mine own chambers shall remain private for long.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00040_KANESENNA
347.description: Has the situation grown so grim?

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00050_NANAMOULNAMO
348.description: Ever since he proposed the Carteneau Reclamation Bill, Teledji Adeledji has risen to greater prominence upon the backs of impoverished refugees.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00060_NANAMOULNAMO
349.description: The Monetarists were ever united in their pursuit of profit, but the man's actions have torn a rift in their ranks. They snap at each other as rabid dogs.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00070_NANAMOULNAMO
350.description: Yet now is not the time to be bickering among ourselves.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00080_MERLWYB
351.description: If this bickering is a threat to law and order, might you not have grounds to dissolve the Syndicate?

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00090_NANAMOULNAMO
352.description: Would that the solution were so simple, Admiral. Alas, my moving to dissolve the Syndicate is certain to spark outrage among the influential merchant class, whom the cabal represents.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00100_NANAMOULNAMO
353.description: This would serve to exacerbate the current unrest, and peace would slip still further away.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00110_NANAMOULNAMO
354.description: Be they rich or poor, natives or refugees, all who reside in Ul'dah have a right to pursue happiness. It is the duty of a ruler to protect this right.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00120_NANAMOULNAMO
355.description: If I am to perform my duty, I must needs tread warily. It would not do to make enemies heedlessly.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00130_NANAMOULNAMO
356.description: Were Lord Lolorito here, he would doubtless say that I have my head in the clouds.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00140_KANESENNA
357.description: A ruler is required to take a wide view. Try as we might to cater to all needs, some will inevitably be overlooked. As such, there shall ever be citizens who feel aggrieved. It cannot be helped.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00150_KANESENNA
358.description: But as you have informed us, the Monetarists take no view but their own. They hunger for power while the masses starve.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00160_KANESENNA
359.description: In the absence of a common cause, it seems beyond any one individual to make Ul'dah whole.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00170_MERLWYB
360.description: And the presence of a Garlean agent within the Immortal Flames only makes matters worse.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00180_MERLWYB
361.description: Even accounting for Ul'dah's historic reliance upon mercenaries, such a grievous breach of security is unprecedented. I fear this business will provide the Monetarists with a rod to beat Raubahn.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00190_KANESENNA
362.description: Eorzea can ill afford for the Immortal Flames to be dampened now. Ere long, the Garleans will turn their ravenous gaze toward our lands once more. If we are to resist their might, our nations must stand together.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00200_KANESENNA
363.description: Yet for this to happen, our nations must be whole. Can naught be done to improve the situation in Ul'dah?

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00210_NANAMOULNAMO
364.description: The true wealth of Ul'dah lies in the health, happiness, and hopes of her citizens. Alas, the citizens shall never know these things so long as their lives are ruled by the ambitions of the few.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00220_NANAMOULNAMO
365.description: The Monetarists claim to represent the best interests of the people, but in sooth they desire only to manipulate them for their own selfish ends.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00230_NANAMOULNAMO
366.description: For the government to serve the people, it must be formed of the people.

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00240_NANAMOULNAMO
367.description: For Ul'dah to move forward, it is not only the Syndicate that must be dissolved.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00260_NANAMOULNAMO
369.description: My friends─it was for no other reason than to make known to you mine intent that I requested your presence here.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00270_NANAMOULNAMO
370.description: When I make my declaration to the people, chaos shall inevitably ensue.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00280_NANAMOULNAMO
371.description: As the last monarch in the line of Ul, I make unto you this request.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00290_NANAMOULNAMO
372.description: Help Raubahn to preserve order, and protect the people. Forsake them, and you forsake yourselves, for a strong Eorzea will ever have need of a strong Ul'dah.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00300_KANESENNA
373.description: Your Grace... Are you certain of this?

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00320_NANAMOULNAMO
375.description: When the time is ripe, the nation shall become a true republic. Both Royalists and Monetarists shall cease to be.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00330_NANAMOULNAMO
376.description: Ul'dah will no longer belong to kings or queens or merchant princes, but to her people.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00340_NANAMOULNAMO
377.description: Raubahn... Forgive me for casting aside all that you have toiled for in my name...

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02400_K00350_NANAMOULNAMO
378.description: Beyond this gesture, I am powerless to help my subjects.
